label: Return request
prompt: I want to return a product.
text: I can help get that started. To route you to the right specialist, could you share the **order number** and the **email** used on the order? Once I have those, I can either pull up the order or hand it off to the returns team directly.

label: Ask for a human
text:
I'll connect you with a specialist. A human will follow up within **24 hours**, and the last 20 turns of our conversation are attached so they have full context.

[Handoff link](/en/contact?topic=averia-handoff&reason=User%20requested%20human%20handoff.)

If your request is time-sensitive, you can also file a support ticket with your email so the team can reach you directly — just let me know.
